name: Kiperina
bio: Archetype: Inspiration, Extra Action, AFK Shield. ⌽ Gains [Eureka] when an ally or Impromptu Incantation lands a Crit. Converts consumed and excess [Eureka] gained into [Auroral Corona]. ⌽ [Auroral Corona] gives team DMG Bonus and additional effects based on its stacks count, including giving all skills extra [Inspiration] and allowing Impromtu Incantation to convert excess Crit Rate into Crit DMG. ⌽ At turn start, cleanses [Control] statuses from allies and consumes [Eureka] to cast Skill 2 based on [Eureka] consumed. ⌽ Skill 2 is a stacking shield that can also buff DMG Bonus and Crit Rate. ⌽ Ultimate cleanses all debuffs from allies and reduces enemy Crit Resist and DMG Taken Reduction.
